simple.meaning: צִיוֹן (tsîyôwn) is a Hebrew word meaning “a desert.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: צִיוֹן (H6724) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Isaiah 25:5, with occurrences in Isaiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to צִיוֹן (H6724) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in צִיוֹן (H6724) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: צִיוֹן (tsîyôwn) / H6724 is traced through Isaiah 25:5, Isaiah 32:2 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
